verdict.rationale: Much of the data plane is programmatic: the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface accept any client, so all SQL operations are available. The first-party MCP server exposes listing services, running SQL and reading monitoring, and CHKit offers typed commands to deploy schema and pipelines as code. Nothing documents a control-plane management API matching the UI, such as creating or resizing clusters, configuring alert rules and webhook destinations, managing SSO and roles, data sharing, or batch-job controls. missing for 10: documented management/control-plane API, explicit API–UI parity claim, programmatic cluster lifecycle and scaling, programmatic alerting/webhook/role configuration, independent corroboration.
